result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on all corners within a residential setting. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, there is a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the crossing distance across the main road is relatively long.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks visible pedestrian signal heads, which can lead to confusion and unsafe crossings.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a refuge island or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. Safety is compromised by faded pavement markings and dense vegetation at the corner that likely obstructs sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the foreground and right side

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: There are no dedicated walk/don't-walk signals, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not account for turning movements.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic light pole at the corner

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and low-hanging tree branches at the corner may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner area behind the traffic light pole

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove dense vegetation at the corner to 'daylight' the intersection and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. Large trees provide shade but may also create visual obstructions for drivers approaching the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and lane markings are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees and shrubs on the corner may block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines by moving pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps within a residential setting. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across the wide intersection without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalks.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the intersection and crosswalk area could pose a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked asphalt to ensure a smooth and safe surface for all road users.
